[[Current_Date]]

Dear [[Tenant_First_Name]],

Welcome to 2nd Chance Housing! Your lease for [[Unit_Address]] is signed, and your resident portal is ready. You can use it 24 hours a day from your phone or computer to:

  • Pay rent and see your payment history
  • Turn on automatic monthly payments (autopay)
  • Send maintenance requests with photos
  • Open your lease and other documents

Signing in: go to [[Portal_URL]] and enter this email address. We email you a code, then text a second code to your phone. There is no password to remember.

Your next step: pay your move-in amount of [[Move_In_Amount]] (security deposit and first month's rent). As soon as it is paid, your keys are released, even before your lease starts on [[Lease_Start_Date]], with no extra charge for moving in early. There are no fees to you for paying online.

If you have any questions, call us at [[Org_Phone]].

Sincerely,

[[Sender_Signature]]
rows.name: 2nd Chance — Welcome Letter

rows.html:
[[Current_Date]]

Dear [[Tenant_First_Name]],

Welcome to [[Unit_Address]]. Here is what to do in your first days, and what to know while you live here.

1. Your move-in checklist (by [[Checklist_Due]]). In your resident portal ([[Portal_URL]]), go room by room, mark the condition of each item and add photos. Your lease gives you 7 days from the start of your tenancy to tell us about any damage or defects that were already there, and to ask for the list of damages charged to the previous tenant's security deposit. The checklist does both. We review it and sign off, and we use it again when you move out, so you are never charged for something that was already there.

2. Autopay (optional). Turn on autopay in the portal and your rent is paid automatically on the 1st. It is free to you.

Repairs. For routine problems, send a request in the portal or call [[Org_Phone]]. For maintenance emergencies (flooding, no heat, no water, a lockout) call [[Emergency_Phone]] any time. For a fire or a gas smell, leave and call 911 first.

Entry. We may enter with 12 hours' advance notice to inspect, make repairs or show the unit, and without notice in a health or safety emergency.

Locks. Neither of us adds or changes locks without giving the other a key. We must always be able to get in during an emergency.

Resident guides. Pest-treatment preparation, lead and radon safety, and city rules: [[Documents_URL]].

Moving out. [[Move_Out_Notice]]

Thank you for choosing 2nd Chance Housing. We look forward to having you as a tenant for many years to come.

Sincerely,

[[Sender_Signature]]
rows.name: 2nd Chance — Move-In Letter

rows.html:
Dear [[Tenant_First_Name]],

Your rent of [[Tenant_Rent_Portion]] is due on the 1st of each month. The easiest way to pay on time is in your resident portal at [[Portal_URL]], on the Payments page:

  • Pay now from your bank account. It is free to you, and it is added to your account the moment you pay.
  • Turn on autopay and your rent is paid from your bank account automatically on the 1st. Never forget rent again.
  • Zelle: the Payments page shows exactly where to send it. Put your account number in the memo and your payment is matched to your account automatically, usually within 1 to 2 business days. You do not need to tell us you paid.
  • Check or money order: the Payments page shows where to mail it. Write your account number on it.

Your account number, your balance and every payment are always shown in the portal.

[[Late_Fee_Policy]]

If you have any questions, or would like help, call or text us at [[Org_Phone]].

Sincerely,

[[Sender_Signature]]
